goal: Flagship depth: a statistically valid slope-change test with power on trend-stationary series
notes: New hinge-test.mjs: sup-F over one continuous hinge, Prais-Winsten AR(1), parametric bootstrap, unit-root guard (0.9; 0.7 under 100 points). Synthetic size 3.0-7.7% in 12 cells (300 series each); power 14-99% vs 0% for the differences test. Pre-registered real run: GCAG, GISTEMP, GCAG-1850 all knot 1976, p 0.001 (differences 0.75-0.80); log GDP and productivity refused. Shipped as --hinge-test, analyze hingeTest, page checkbox, llms.txt.
